comments.body:
The behavior change is right (a VCS entry shouldn't lose its marker), but the Smoke jobs fail on all three OSes:

```
FAILED tests/integration/test_lockfile.py::test_git_branch_contains_slashes
```

That test checks the exact requirement line for a git dependency, which now ends with `; python_version >= '3.7'`. Please update its expectation.

Two more things:

1. When an entry has both `os_markers` and `markers`, this writes `pkg @ git+... ; A; B`, which isn't valid PEP 508. The file and index branches already have the same bug, so it would be good to fix all three here by combining the two with ` and `, e.g. `; (A) and (B)`.
2. `requirement_from_lockfile` also builds `pip_line_specified` in `Lockfile.requirements_list`, which sync uses to install. So pip now gets the marker on install as well as in `pipenv requirements`. That's harmless because the marker is already evaluated separately on `install_req`, but please mention it in the description so the install-side effect is on record.

Thanks for the review. Pushed:

- `test_git_branch_contains_slashes` now expects the marker the git entry keeps.
- `os_markers` and `markers` are combined as `; (A) and (B)` on the git, file and index forms (it was `; A; B`), with a unit test covering all three.

Added to the description, as asked: `requirement_from_lockfile` also builds `pip_line_specified` in `Lockfile.requirements_list`, which sync uses to install, so pip now receives the marker on install as well as in `pipenv requirements`. The marker is already evaluated separately on `install_req`, so installs don't change.

The unit tests and the two git tests in `tests/integration/test_lockfile.py` pass locally; the full smoke jobs were not run.

This comment was drafted with the help of an AI agent (Claude) working on behalf of the PR author.
